zh.title: 俄無人機逼近邊境 波蘭升空戰機並暫停兩座機場起降
zh.summary: 波蘭防空因俄無人機逼近提警報；戰機升空；盧布林與熱舒夫機場暫停起降
body: 波蘭政府安全中心（RCB）於 2026 年 9 月 17 日向盧布林省與喀爾巴阡山省居民發出空襲警報。主因是一架俄羅斯噴射動力無人機接近波蘭邊境，波蘭武裝部隊作戰指揮部（DORSZ）隨即緊急升空戰鬥機應對，並將地面防空系統升至待命狀態。
為配合軍機行動，波蘭航行服務局（PANSA）暫停了盧布林機場（LUZ）與熱舒夫-加遜卡機場（RZE）的航班起降。波蘭軍方指出，該架無人機最終落在烏克蘭境內 3 至 4 公里處，未記錄到波蘭領空遭侵犯的狀況。相關空襲警報已於當地時間 12 時 48 分解除。

en.title: Poland Scrambles Fighters and Suspends Flights at Two Airports as Russian Drone Nears Border
en.summary: Polish military scrambled fighters and suspended flights at two airports on September 17 after Russian drone approached.
body: Poland’s Government Center for Security (RCB) issued an air attack alert for Lublin and Subcarpathian voivodeships on September 17, 2026, as a Russian jet-powered drone approached the Polish border. In response, Poland’s Armed Forces Operational Command (DORSZ) scrambled fighter aircraft and placed ground-based air defense systems on readiness.

To grant military aviation freedom of action, the Polish Air Navigation Services Agency (PANSA) temporarily suspended flight operations at Lublin Airport (LUZ) and Rzeszów-Jasionka Airport (RZE). Military officials stated that the drone crashed 3 to 4 kilometers inside Ukraine, with no violation of Polish airspace recorded, and the alert was officially lifted at 12:48 local time.

facts.sourceQuote: The Polish Air Navigation Services Agency (PANSA) said that Lublin Airport (LUZ) and Rzeszów-Jasionka Airport (RZE) had temporarily suspended flight operations to give military aviation freedom of action.
